sourceText.he: מַתְנִי׳ בְּכוֹר שֶׁנִּתְעָרֵב בְּמֵאָה, בִּזְמַן שֶׁמֵּאָה שׁוֹחֲטִין אֶת כּוּלָּן – פּוֹטְרִים אֶת כּוּלָּן, אֶחָד שׁוֹחֵט אֶת כּוּלָּן – פּוֹטְרִים לוֹ אֶחָד.
הַשּׁוֹחֵט לַכֹּהֵן וְלַגּוֹי – פָּטוּר מִן הַמַּתָּנוֹת, וְהַמִּשְׁתַּתֵּף עִמָּהֶן – צָרִיךְ שֶׁיִּרְשׁוֹם, וְאִם אָמַר: ״חוּץ מִן הַמַּתָּנוֹת״ – פָּטוּר מִן הַמַּתָּנוֹת.

אָמַר: ״מְכוֹר לִי בְּנֵי מֵעֶיהָ שֶׁל פָּרָה״, וְהָיוּ בָּהֶן מַתָּנוֹת – נוֹתְנָן לַכֹּהֵן, וְאֵינוֹ מְנַכֶּה לוֹ מִן הַדָּמִים. לְקָחָן הֵימֶנּוּ בְּמִשְׁקָל – נוֹתְנָן לַכֹּהֵן, וּמְנַכֶּה לוֹ מִן הַדָּמִים.

positions.claim: when a hundred different people each slaughter one of a hundred animals among which a blemished firstborn was intermingled, all are exempt from the gifts, but when one person slaughters them all only one animal is exempted for him
positions.basis: each slaughterer can claim that his animal was the firstborn

positions.claim: one who slaughters a priest's animal for the priest, or a gentile's animal for the gentile, is exempt from the gifts, and an Israelite in partnership with them must mark the animal
a priest who sells his animal 'except for the gifts' leaves the Israelite buyer exempt from them
positions.basis: the gifts were never sold and so are not his

positions.claim: one who buys innards outright gives the maw to the priest without deducting its value, but one who buys them by weight deducts it
positions.basis: buying outright, he knew the maw was included in the innards
